title: Sunday Morning Worship & Family Service
description: Join our church family for uplifting worship music, a message from God's Word on finding community, and full children's programming for infants through 5th grade. Coffee and refreshments served in the lobby beforehand.

title: Sunday Evening Youth Rally & Fellowship
description: Middle and high school students gather for high-energy group games, worship led by the youth band, small group breakout discussions, and pizza. New students are warmly invited.

title: Midweek Community Dinner & Bible Study
description: A weekly family dinner followed by age-appropriate Bible studies for adults, youth, and kids. This week begins a 6-week study through the Book of Ephesians focusing on walking in unity.

title: Fall Harvest Community Food Drive
description: Pack and distribute emergency grocery hampers for local families in need in partnership with the regional food bank. Volunteers will sort donations, assemble care boxes, and assist with drive-through loading.

title: Worship Team Auditions & Workshop
description: An open workshop and casual audition evening for vocalists, guitarists, drummers, and keyboard players interested in serving on the Sunday morning worship rotation. Materials provided upon RSVP.

title: Kids Camp Volunteer Orientation
description: Essential training and safety orientation for all helpers and group leaders serving in upcoming fall kids events. Covers curriculum overview, child protection guidelines, and team assignments.

title: Men's Monthly Breakfast & Fellowship
description: Hearty cooked breakfast, hot coffee, and an encouraging testimony from guest speaker Pastor Dan on balancing faith, family, and work. Bring a neighbor or friend.

title: Serve Day
description: Teams spread out to help local schools, a food pantry, and elderly neighbors with yard work. All ages welcome; meet in the main parking lot.

title: Welcome to Grace Newcomers Luncheon
description: Are you new to Grace Community in the past few months? Enjoy a complimentary catered lunch with pastors and ministry leaders, ask questions, and learn more about getting connected.

title: Prayer & Worship Night of Renewal
description: An evening set aside for extended acoustic worship, silent reflection, guided corporate prayer, and anointing prayer for healing and encouragement.
